details: Bitcoin climbed over 15% since Monday, surpassing $72,000 for the first time since June, reaching $72,207. This surge is attributed to the US Treasury doubling its long-end bond buyback operations to at least $4 billion per operation, effective September 9 through November 4, 2026. This move eased long-term yields, which had been pressuring risk assets. Additionally, President Trump's renewed efforts to push for the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act in Congress contributed to the bullish sentiment by reducing regulatory uncertainty. The rally also triggered over $3.1 billion in short liquidations.
title: Bitcoin Surges Past $72,000 as US Treasury Doubles Bond Buybacks and Trump Backs Crypto Legislation

details: The US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has proposed "Regulation Crypto Assets," which aims to create a legal framework for crypto projects to sell tokens directly to US investors. The proposal introduces two exemptions from Securities Act registration, allowing raises of up to $5 million over four years or up to $75 million annually with financial disclosures. Crucially, it also includes a "safe harbor" mechanism for tokens to exit securities treatment once essential managerial efforts are completed, addressing a key issue highlighted by the XRP lawsuit. Grayscale Research suggests Ethereum, Solana, and BNB Chain could be major beneficiaries as legal token sales are expected to increase on-chain activity.
title: New SEC Crypto Rules Proposed, Offering Clear Path for Token Sales and Exit from Securities Status

details: Ethereum developers have launched the Plataberget public testnet for the upcoming "Glamsterdam" upgrade. This significant upgrade aims to overhaul the network's consensus and execution layers, with the goal of tripling its transaction capacity per block by increasing the gas limit from 60 million to 200 million. Public testing will continue for months on various testnets before a planned mainnet activation in Q4 2026. This enhancement is expected to boost network utility, reduce costs for Layer 2 rollups, and potentially attract fresh capital to the ecosystem.
title: Ethereum Launches Plataberget Testnet for Glamsterdam Upgrade, Aiming to Triple Block Capacity
